Advanced V.G..name: Advanced V.G.
Advanced V.G..summary: An updated re-release of the original Variable Geo fighting game that removes the hentai scenes.

DeJig - Tin Toy.name: Dejig: Tin Toy
DeJig - Tin Toy.summary: A jigsaw puzzle game for the Sega Saturn in which players build images of children's toys based around vehicles, machinery, or industry.

Farland Saga - Toki no Michishirube.name: Farland Saga: Toki no Michishirube
Farland Saga - Toki no Michishirube.summary: Toki no Michishirube is a direct sequel to the first Farland Saga game. It is an anime-style strategy RPG which consists mainly of large strategic battles, taking place on isometric battle fields.

Shinobi Legions.name: Shinobi Legions
Shinobi Legions.summary: Shinobi Legions, known as Shinobi X in Europe and as Shin Shinobi Den in Japan, is the fifth and final game in the original Shinobi series. It was developed and published by Sega in 1995 for the Sega Saturn.
